name: lwr
description: A rate-limit runway plugin, set up here as a safe minimal skeleton: ships one no-op rule, lwr_version, which allows every event and reports the plugin's version. Policy is per-rule off/warn/deny, fails open (a missing or broken policy file never blocks a dispatch), and the engine is pure — see core/lwr_core/engine.py. LWR's real runway rules (wind-down/landing/handoff-only/retire) are built in a later session.
